caveats: Requires Paseo 0.10.2 or newer on both the daemon and the app.
Shows whether a snippet's terminal is open, not whether its command is still running or how it exited.
Detects scripts from the root package.json only; monorepo packages are not scanned.
Snippets live in host-wide plugin settings shared by every client of the daemon, so do not put secrets in them.
Running from the sidebar screen reuses or creates the project's Local workspace, never a worktree.
Verified end to end on macOS only.
